name: Obsolete SYSLIB or external obsolete API usage
description: Flags representative SYSLIB and EXTOBS obsolete API evidence emitted by semantic extraction.
impact: Obsolete APIs can represent platform behavior that has changed, become unsupported, or requires explicit replacement before modernization.
evidenceRequirements: Roslyn semantic extraction must provide symbol, attribute, or diagnostic-style facts for obsolete API usage.
recommendedActions: Use the exact obsolete diagnostic or symbol evidence to select a supported replacement API.
